name: Social Share
project_description: Social Share (8.x-2.x) provides a 'social share link' plugin type together with a field type, a field formatter and a block that let editors expose configurable share links (Facebook, Twitter/X, LinkedIn, Pinterest, WhatsApp, e-mail, plus Print and PDF links). Each share provider is an annotated SocialShareLink plugin defining its own context parameters (title, URL, description, hashtags, etc.); those context values accept Typed Data placeholder tokens that are resolved against the surrounding entity at render time. Every plugin renders through its own Twig template so themes fully control the markup, and share URLs are built with plain query strings plus a tiny popup.js — no external network SDK/JavaScript is loaded, keeping the buttons privacy friendly. The special value '<current>' in a URL context resolves to the current page URL. Requires the Typed Data module.
